engrData.note: p 445 is a specimen 'M FD RECORD' (SECRET when completed), filled in as an example (a Fd Coy, Minefield EF 163, map sheet 44 L/15, 1:50,000; names left out here). Its figures are an example, not planning data. The contents page lists it at 444.

specimen.note: as printed in the example; the A tk figures add up (102 + 114 + 121 = 337, booby trapped 16 + 12 = 28), the A pers ones do not (IOE 57 + 12 = 69 vs total 66; Type No 1 Mk 1 total 818 vs strip A 261)

lanes.HowMarked: Sig cable picketed with gr along CL

rules: 1. All spaces on the form must always be filled in.
2. If the time is short, the form must be completed down.
3. Max length of a M fd to be recorded on one form is approx 600 yds.
4. When an existing M fd is changed, a new form will be submitted showing the entire M fd after changes.
5. When laid mech, rows will be lettered commencing from the en side of the M fd.
6. Nuisance M fds will be lettered serially and recorded in the strip table of the Form.
7. When, as above, ltrs ref to rows laid mech or to nuisance M fd sers, the recorder will amend the 'STRIP' or 'NUISANCE M FD', as appropriate.
8. Any addl info nec may be shown on sketch, or on space provided for notes.

9. Sketch must always show: a. the scale, normally 1 in equals 50 paces or larger; b. all landmks and intmed markers if used, a min of two landmks; c. bgs (mag) and paced dists from landmks to intmed markers, to strip markers at beginning and end of rear strip, to lane entrances, to fence, and for each straight line sec of lanes; d. mag north and dir of en; e. approx trace of protective fence; f. length and depth of M fd.
10. If ordered: bg and dist for each straight line sec of the strips; bg and dist b/w the starting and finishing pts of the strips; addl info as considered nec.

4. Mk 5 ATMs can be planted in pairs, one on top of the other.

engrData.title: Inundation - Approx Time Calc
engrData.note: Const of one compartment assumptions: length 1000 yds; 4 Size II Dozers; output of Size II Dozer 40 cu yds (150 ft Haul) per Hr; 4 Pls; reasonably lvl gr; assumed cross sec of dyke (drawing) 4 ft top, 18 ft base, 3.5 ft high. remarks: Const notes: (1) For subsequent multiples of 1000 yds length deduct approx 1/2 to 1 day to cater for each common dyke between two adjacent compartments (e.g. 5 addl compartments deduct 5x1/2=2 1/2 days). Filling note: Approx time can be calc for various multiples of 1000 yds length.

Saturation notes: 1. Eff bog will be created if soil is saturated to a depth of 2 to 3 ft. 2. Soils liable to be saturated to a depth of 2 to 3 ft in 2 to 4 days are suitable for inundation. 3. Loss of water through percolation should be excessive. 4. After saturation about six ins of water level will be maint above inundated surface throughout.
